sentences.text: MR. H.L.JANI, APP for the Applicant(s) No. 1
RULE SERVED for the Respondent(s) No. 1 - 2

==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE RAJESH H.SHUKLA  Date : 03/11/2015  ORAL ORDER 1.

The present application is filed by the Applicant - State of Gujarat under Section 378(1)(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking leave to appeal challenging the impugned judgment and order rendered in Criminal Case No. 291 of 2002 by the learned 2nd Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kachchh dated 27.1.2015 recording acquittal of the Respondents Accused for the offence under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
2. Heard learned APP Shri H.L.Jani for the Applicant State of Gujarat.
Though served no one has remained present for Respondents Accused.

HC-NIC Page 1 of 2 Created On Wed Nov 04 02:44:05  State Of Gujarat vs Viralkumar Pravinchandra Bhatt & on 3 November, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27419303/
1  R/CR.MA/11936/2015 ORDE 3.

In view of the reasons recorded and having heard learned APP Shri H.L.Jani for the Applicant State of Gujarat, the present application seeking leave to appeal deserves to be allowed and accordingly stands allowed.

(RAJESH H.SHUKLA, J.) JNW HC-NIC Page 2 of 2 Created On Wed Nov 04 02:44:05 IST 2015 State Of Gujarat vs Viralkumar Pravinchandra Bhatt & on 3 November, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27419303/
